properties.title: dApp Connection Required Before Permission Request
properties.description: Before wallet_requestPermissions can be processed, a dApp must have an established connection to the wallet
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request IN wallet_requestPermissions: EXISTS connection(request.invoker, wallet) AND connection.established == true

properties.title: User Consent Required for Permission Grant
properties.description: No permission can be granted without explicit user approval via the consent prompt
properties.formal_spec: FORALL p IN granted_permissions: EXISTS consent_event(p) WHERE consent_event.user_action == 'approve' AND consent_event.timestamp < p.grant_timestamp

properties.title: Rejection Returns Error 4001
properties.description: When a user rejects a permission request, the wallet must return JSON-RPC error code 4001 per EIP-1193
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request IN wallet_requestPermissions: user_rejects(request) IMPLIES response.error.code == 4001

properties.title: Permission Lookup Before Restricted Method Execution
properties.description: Before executing any restricted method, the wallet must perform permission lookup for the invoker
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call IN restricted_method_calls: lookup_permission(call.invoker, call.method) EXECUTES BEFORE method_execution(call)

properties.title: Caveat Validation Enforced on Every Call
properties.description: Every call to a permissioned method must validate all associated caveats even if permission exists
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call IN permissioned_calls WHERE permission_exists(call.invoker, call.method): validate_caveats(permission.caveats, call.params) == true BEFORE execution

properties.title: No Permission Implies Method Denied
properties.description: When no valid permission exists for an invoker and method, the call must be denied
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call IN method_calls: NOT permission_exists(call.invoker, call.method) AND is_restricted(call.method) IMPLIES call.result == DENIED

properties.title: Permission Query Returns Only Invoker's Permissions
properties.description: wallet_getPermissions must only return permissions belonging to the requesting invoker
properties.formal_spec: FORALL p IN getPermissions_result(invoker): p.invoker == invoker

properties.title: URL Scheme Validation Before Fetch
properties.description: Any URL provided in permission requests must be validated against allowed schemes before fetching
properties.formal_spec: FORALL url IN permission_request_urls: fetch(url) REQUIRES url.scheme IN {'http', 'https'}

properties.title: Invalid URL Scheme Blocks Request
properties.description: URLs with schemes not in the whitelist must be blocked without making network requests
properties.formal_spec: FORALL url IN permission_request_urls: url.scheme NOT IN allowed_schemes IMPLIES url_blocked(url) AND NOT network_request_made(url)

properties.title: Port Validation Prevents Local Service Access
properties.description: URL port validation must prevent access to common local service ports
properties.formal_spec: FORALL url IN validated_urls: url.port NOT IN local_service_ports OR url_blocked(url)

properties.title: Hex Prefix Check Before Conversion
properties.description: Before converting hex string to bytes, the 0x prefix must be checked and removed if present
properties.formal_spec: FORALL input IN hex_to_bytes_calls: prefix_check(input) EXECUTES BEFORE fromhex(input)

properties.title: Fixed-Size Output Guarantee
properties.description: After conversion, the output bytes array must have exactly the expected size (8, 32, or 256 bytes)
properties.formal_spec: FORALL output IN hex_to_bytesN(input, N): length(output) == N

properties.title: Padding Preserves Numeric Value
properties.description: Zero padding must not alter the numeric value represented by the hex string
properties.formal_spec: FORALL input IN hex_strings: numeric_value(pad(input)) == numeric_value(input)

properties.title: Prefix Stripped Before Base-16 Parsing
properties.description: Before parsing hex string as integer, the 0x prefix must be removed
properties.formal_spec: FORALL input IN hex_to_int_calls: remove_hex_prefix(input) EXECUTES BEFORE int(input, 16)

properties.title: Type Wrapper Applied After Parsing
properties.description: After parsing hex to integer, the result must be wrapped in the appropriate type constructor
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call IN hex_to_U256(input): type(result) == U256 AND result.value == int(input, 16)

properties.title: Fixed Size Enforced at Trust Boundary
properties.description: At trust boundaries, all hex conversions to fixed-size types must enforce exact output size
properties.formal_spec: FORALL output IN boundary_hex_conversions: output.size == target_type.required_size

properties.title: Right-Justify Padding Correct
properties.description: Padding must use right-justify with leading zeros to maintain numeric equivalence
properties.formal_spec: FORALL padded IN rjust_outputs: padded == '0' * (target_len - len(input)) + input

properties.title: Precompile Check Before Dispatch
properties.description: Before dispatching to a precompile handler, the address must be looked up in PRE_COMPILED_CONTRACTS
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call IN calls_to_address: is_precompile(call.address) == (call.address IN PRE_COMPILED_CONTRACTS)

properties.title: Handler Retrieved Before Execution
properties.description: For precompile addresses, the handler function must be retrieved before execution
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call IN precompile_calls: retrieve_handler(call.address) RETURNS handler AND handler EXECUTES WITH call.data

properties.title: Non-Precompile Addresses Treated as Regular Contracts
properties.description: Addresses not in the precompile mapping must be treated as regular contract addresses
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call IN calls_to_address: call.address NOT IN PRE_COMPILED_CONTRACTS IMPLIES treat_as_regular_contract(call)

properties.title: Address-to-Handler Mapping Immutable
properties.description: The mapping between precompile addresses and handler functions must be immutable during execution
properties.formal_spec: FORALL t1, t2 IN execution_timeline: PRE_COMPILED_CONTRACTS(t1) == PRE_COMPILED_CONTRACTS(t2)

properties.title: Correct Handler Dispatched for Address
properties.description: Each precompile address must dispatch to its specific designated handler
properties.formal_spec: dispatch(0x01) == ecrecover AND dispatch(0x02) == sha256 AND dispatch(0x0a) == point_evaluation

properties.title: Fork Context Active Before Precompile Load
properties.description: The correct fork context must be active before loading fork-specific precompile configuration
properties.formal_spec: FORALL execution IN evm_executions: fork_context.active == true BEFORE load_precompiles(fork_context.fork)

properties.title: Cancun Fork Has Point Evaluation Precompile
properties.description: In Cancun fork context, the point_evaluation precompile at 0x0a must be available
properties.formal_spec: fork_context == Cancun IMPLIES 0x0a IN PRE_COMPILED_CONTRACTS AND PRE_COMPILED_CONTRACTS[0x0a] == point_evaluation

properties.title: Unavailable Precompile Treated as Empty Account
properties.description: Calls to precompile addresses not available in the current fork must be treated as calls to empty accounts
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call IN precompile_address_calls: call.address NOT IN current_fork.precompiles IMPLIES treat_as_empty_account(call)

properties.title: Permission Storage Protected from Tampering
properties.description: The wallet's permission storage must be protected from modification by external entities
properties.formal_spec: FORALL modification IN permission_storage_changes: modification.source == wallet_internal_only

properties.title: Invalid Hex Characters Cause Error
properties.description: Hex strings containing characters outside 0-9, a-f, A-F must raise ValueError
properties.formal_spec: FORALL input IN hex_inputs: contains_invalid_char(input) IMPLIES raises(ValueError)

properties.title: No Code Deployable at Precompile Addresses
properties.description: Contract deployment must be rejected for addresses 0x01 through 0x0a reserved for precompiles
properties.formal_spec: FORALL deploy IN contract_deployments: deploy.address IN [0x01..0x0a] IMPLIES deploy.rejected == true

properties.title: Permission Object Contains Required Fields
properties.description: After granting, each permission object must contain invoker, parentCapability, and caveats fields
properties.formal_spec: FORALL p IN granted_permissions: p.invoker != null AND p.parentCapability != null AND p.caveats IS array

properties.title: Gas Available Before Precompile Execution
properties.description: Sufficient gas must be available before executing the precompile handler
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call IN precompile_calls: call.gas_available >= precompile_gas_cost(call.address, call.data)

properties.title: Target Size Determined Before Padding
properties.description: The target output size must be determined before calculating padding requirements
properties.formal_spec: FORALL conversion IN fixed_size_conversions: determine_target_size(conversion) EXECUTES BEFORE calculate_padding(conversion)
